about: The one price table of every Napkin tool. USD per million tokens: [input, output, cache read]. A cache write is cache_write_mult x the input price (the 5-minute cache). A model id matches its longest listed prefix, after any wire or Bedrock prefix (bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 is claude-opus-5-5). Read by engine/price_table.py (the Deck, Territory, the bench, the rag evals) and by server/napkin/runlog.py and server/tools/run_report.py. Anthropic list prices as of 3 Nov 2026 (Fable 5.1's cache read as read from the pricing page on 30 Sep 2026); a cache read is listed per model because it is not one share of the input price (0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, 0.1x on the older models). Change a price here and only here.
unlisted_note: An id that matches nothing is priced as Opus 5.5, the dearest model the tools route to by default, so a new model never looks free. The run log instead reports an unlisted model as unpriced (None).
